# Football Parent

Website: https://www.footballparent.co.uk

Football Parent is an independent UK website helping parents understand youth football in England.

Primary topics

- Football academies
- Academy trials
- Development centres
- Football scouting
- Junior Premier League
- Grassroots football
- Player development
- Football parenting
- Girls football pathways
- Football kit and equipment for children (boots, shin pads, goalkeeper gloves, footballs)
- Grassroots coaching (sessions, formations, equal playing time, coaching apps)

Audience

Parents of children aged approximately 5–18 involved in youth football.

Editorial principles

- UK-specific advice
- Independent editorial content
- Evidence-based guidance
- Parent-first perspective
- Regularly updated

Football Gear
https://www.footballparent.co.uk/football-gear
Buying guides for children's football kit, tested by a parent and coach: boots by age, foot shape and pitch surface, shin pads, goalkeeper gloves, footballs and training equipment.

Coaching
https://www.footballparent.co.uk/coaching
Practical guides for grassroots coaches: session ideas, formations by age group, equal playing time and reviews of coaching apps.
